source.description: How the saved raster contact sheet was obtained.
source.notes: Any rejected previews, repairs, or source constraints.

process_strategy: Seven cumulative panels move from sparse primitives to silhouette, parts, features, details, ink and color map, then a finishing-only final.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using only the listed primitives, axes, routes, and placement ticks.

anchor_map.early_mark: A named Panel 1 primitive, route, or prop footprint
anchor_map.becomes: The exact named later feature it supports
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Its attachment point, direction, and overlap relation remain stable in every later panel.
anchor_map.construction_note: State whether the early guide is an allowed closed primitive, an open route with named endpoints, or a placement footprint.

final_elements.name: primary silhouette
final_elements.description: The dominant outer form, first reserved with primitives and only closed in the silhouette stage.

final_elements.name: major attached parts
final_elements.description: Large fins, limbs, handles, petals, or other attached forms added after the main silhouette.

final_elements.name: identity features
final_elements.description: Windows, face construction, inner shapes, folds, or other recognizable landmarks.

final_elements.name: secondary details
final_elements.description: Small markings, expression details, texture routes, and highlight reservations.

final_elements.name: marker palette
final_elements.description: Every major black-outline and marker-color region shown before the finishing panel.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Primary keeper lines stop at simple placement ticks or open reserved routes for later attached parts.

frames.visible_job: Place two to five simple primitives, one axis or gesture route, and only the attachment ticks needed for later parts.
construction_primitives: one main circle, ellipse, box, or open envelope
small placement ticks for later attached parts
must_not_show: marker color, highlights, texture, or finished shadow

frames.visible_job: Connect only the dominant outer form over the construction while keeping attached parts and internal features absent.
Add the large attached forms or overlaps at the reserved locations without drawing later internal features.
adds: large attached forms at their reserved locations

frames.visible_job: Add the planned face construction, window, fold, inner shape, or other identity-defining landmarks.
Add the planned small markings, expression details, texture routes, and open-paper highlight reservations.
adds: small subject-specific details and highlight reserves

frames.visible_job: Ink only established contours and show every major marker-color region before the finishing panel.
must_not_show: final tiny highlights and shadow accents

final_step.visible_job: Only complete established marker fills, strengthen selected keeper contours, and add small highlights or shadow accents.

rejection_checks: Panel 1 must stay under 30 percent structural completion and use only the listed primitives, routes, and placement ticks.
No closed future feature may appear early as a pale guide; omit it until its assigned stage.
No more than one transition may rely mainly on tracing the same geometry darker.
Every frame must add its declared visible work and keep every must_not_show item absent.
Every major contour and color region must be established before the final panel.
The final image must keep the same pose, scale, and placement as the step frames.
